title: Value outside a listed coordinate set
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\rho$ assign a restriction state to each of the $n$ coordinates, let $L$ be a list of coordinates, and let $x\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$. At any coordinate $j$ not in $L$, fixing the coordinates in $L$ according to the signs encoded by $x$ leaves the state equal to $\rho_j$.
